parts.text: 站点配置指向 `D:/repository/苏住房防汛C端/dist/build/h5`，端口为 8103。我会检查 dist 目录和 nginx 是否正在运行。

tool_input.command: $dist='D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端\dist\build\h5'; Write-Host "=== dist 目录 ==="; if(Test-Path $dist){ $f=Get-ChildItem $dist -Recurse -File; Write-Host "  exists=True files=$($f.Count) lastWrite=$(($f | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).LastWriteTime)" }else{ Write-Host "  exists=False" }; Write-Host "`n=== nginx 进程 ==="; $np=Get-Process nginx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($np){ $np | Select-Object Id,ProcessName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 40 }else{ Write-Host "  nginx 未运行" }; Write-Host "=== 8103 端口 ==="; (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8103 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count

parts.text: nginx 正在运行，8803 端口正在监听，dist 目录有 38 个文件。现在验证站点能否实际访问。

tool_input.command: try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8103/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) len=$($r.Content.Length)"; Write-Host "=== title / 关键标记 ==="; if($r.Content -match '<title>(.*?)</title>'){ Write-Host "title: $($matches[1])" }; ($r.Content | Select-String 'src="[^"]*\.js"' -AllMatches).Matches | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } }catch{ Write-Host "ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

parts.text:
站点返回 HTTP 200，标题为“苏住房防台防汛”，资源加载正常。

再通过本机外部 IP 确认局域网也能访问，并检查各路由页面。

tool_input.command: $ip=(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' } | Select-Object -First 1).IPAddress; Write-Host "本机 IP: $ip"; Write-Host "`n=== 各入口测试 ==="; foreach($u in "http://127.0.0.1:8103/","http://${ip}:8103/"){ try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8; Write-Host "  $u -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode)" }catch{ Write-Host "  $u -> ERR $($_.Exception.Message.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(60,$_.Exception.Message.Length)))" } }
tool_input.description: Test both localhost and LAN access

parts.text: 本机回环地址和 172.19.16.1 都能访问。但 172.19.16.1 属于 WSL 虚拟网卡，不一定是你在外部访问时用的地址，需要确认实际可用的局域网 IP。

tool_input.command: Write-Host "=== 所有 IPv4 地址 ==="; Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' } | Select-Object IPAddress, InterfaceAlias, PrefixOrigin | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80; Write-Host "=== 之前 Nacos 注册用的 192.168.1.129 是否本机 ==="; $has129 = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -eq '192.168.1.129' }; Write-Host "  存在=$([bool]$has129)"

parts.text: 真正对外访问可用的局域网地址是 `192.168.1.129`（以太网 2）。接下来验证这个地址能否访问。

tool_input.command: try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.129:8103/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8; Write-Host "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) len=$($r.Content.Length)" }catch{ Write-Host "ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)" }; Write-Host "`n=== 防火墙规则检查（8103）==="; $fw=Get-NetFirewallRule -Enabled True -Direction Inbound -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-NetFirewallPortFilter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 8103 }; Write-Host "  匹配规则数: $(($fw|Measure-Object).Count)"
tool_input.description: Verify LAN IP access and firewall
